stem: Dalton’s Law of Partial Pressures: A mixture of $2.00\text{~g}$ of $\text{He}$ and $8.00\text{~g}$ of $\text{Ar}$ is placed in a rigid $5.00\text{-L}$ container at $25^{\circ}\text{C}$. What is the total pressure of the gas mixture?
sourceExplanation: $n\left( \text{He} \right) = 2.0/4.003 = 0.50\text{~mol}$; $n\left( \text{Ar} \right) = 8.0/39.95 = 0.20\text{~mol}$. Total $n = 0.70\text{~mol}$. $P = nRT/V = (0.70 \times 0.08206 \times 298.15)/5.00 = 3.42\text{~atm}$? Wait, let's recalculate: $0.7 \times 0.0821 \times 298/5 = 3.42\text{~atm}$. Option D is $3.42\text{~atm}$. (D)
